title: Archive of Sources
description: Research links, institutional sources, and portrait credits for THE INFINITE LIBRARY. Portraits ship as original illustrative museum plates with honest attribution links (Wikimedia Commons / institutional pages). Wikimedia image downloads were rate-limited (HTTP 429) during build; plates never claim photographic rights we do not hold.
